goal: Test whether pre-draw lottery-number distributions exhibit stable information-geometric structure on the probability simplex that improves frozen ranking out of sample.

nearestPriorFamilies.difference: Energy distance is a Euclidean discrepancy family; v317 uses Fisher-Rao/Hellinger geometry on normalized probability measures.
Optimal transport uses transport plans and ground costs; v317 uses intrinsic simplex geometry without transport plans.

design.representation: Construct trailing pre-draw normalized number-frequency measures using only prior draws.

geometry.primaryDistance: Fisher-Rao geodesic distance via square-root embedding
geometry.reference: frozen trailing barycentric reference on the statistical simplex
geometry.score: rank numbers by frozen contribution to geodesic displacement toward historically recurrent pre-draw states

matchedCostNulls: uniform random lines at identical line count

inference.primaryMetric: paired mean main-number hits per line versus matched-cost null
inference.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across frozen candidates within each game plus family-level hard audit for any extreme event
inference.extremeEventAudit: Any 5+, full hit, repeat5+ or corrected statistical anomaly requires lineage verification, timestamp verification, behavioral deduplication, matched-cost null replay and untouched post-freeze replication before interpretation.
inference.promotionRule: No real-money promotion from v317 alone; untouched prospective replication is mandatory.

failureGate: Persist as negative and do not retune if OOS uplift disappears, fails multiplicity correction, is explained by marginal-frequency/recency baselines, or any extreme event fails audit.
